selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: 3-member Galera cluster formed and healthy with app data replicated
selected_evidence.summary: Cluster bootstrapped on node1 and joined by node2/node3 (cluster_size 1->2->3, Primary/ready); appdb.orders rows inserted on node1 and confirmed identical on node2 and node3.

selected_evidence.requirement: Full cluster shutdown for maintenance window
selected_evidence.summary: node3, node2, then node1 stopped in order (node1 grastate.dat shows safe_to_bootstrap:1, seqno 11); systemctl is-active confirms all three mariadb instances inactive simultaneously.

selected_evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back with all committed writes present and all 3 members serving
selected_evidence.summary: node1 re-bootstrapped, node2 and node3 rejoined via SST (cluster_size back to 3, Primary); pre-shutdown rows verified identical on all 3 nodes; new write from node2 replicated and counted (4 rows) on node1 and node3, proving full read/write cluster recovery with no data loss.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id df9e2dce.../Synced/size3 captured; reboot acknowledged; connection reset confirmed disconnect; post-reboot boot_id c9ecec1c... (changed) confirmed; mariadb active, cluster_size 3/Primary/Synced, 4 rows intact.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 37344ae4.../Synced/size3 captured; reboot acknowledged; connection reset confirmed disconnect; post-reboot boot_id a4aa638f... (changed) confirmed; mariadb active, cluster_size 3/Primary/Synced, 4 rows intact.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4d70780a.../Synced/size3 captured; reboot acknowledged; connection reset confirmed disconnect; post-reboot boot_id 4e89a843... (changed) confirmed; mariadb active, cluster_size 3/Primary/Synced, 4 rows intact.

selected_evidence.requirement: Final full-cluster consistency after all restarts
selected_evidence.summary: All three nodes report cluster_size 3, Synced state, and byte-identical 4-row appdb.orders dataset after sequential individual restarts.
